bagPolicy.summary: The State Room hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: The State Room hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The State Room. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The State Room is a 21 and over venue with a full bar.
concessions.quote: We are a 21 and over venue with full bar.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating tickets are available for every show. Choose those tickets when you buy, and your spot will be set up by the time you arrive.
accessibility.quote: Accessible seating tickets are available for all shows at The State Room.

reEntry.summary: The State Room hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens on show days at the posted door time, and tickets are also sold in person at Graywhale Entertainment. AXS is the only official ticket source, and resale tickets bought elsewhere may be refused. The venue is 21 and over.
ticketPickup.quote: The State Room Box Office is open on show days at the posted door time.

gates.summary: Doors open at the time posted for each show. Have your ticket ready in the AXS app to scan at the gate.
gates.quote: Show the tickets in-app at the gate to scan for entry.
